pop_change_21.label: Population change since mid-2021, per cent
pop_change_21.source: ONS, Mid-Year Population Estimates, England and Wales, June 2025 edition (published 29 July 2026), MYE4 series mid-2011 to mid-2025 as revised; ukdemographics src/data/live/population-estimates.json. Counts: usual residents.

value_used.2022-05-05: not defined: no mid-year value after mid-2021 is dated before this polling day

nino_rate.label: NINo registrations to adult overseas nationals in the calendar year before polling day, per 1,000 residents
nino_rate.source: DWP Stat-Xplore, NINo registrations to adult overseas nationals, calendar years 2002 to 2025; ukdemographics nino-historical.json (lastUpdated 2026-04-29). Counts: new registrations (a flow, not a stock). Denominator: ONS mid-year estimate of the same year.

nino_change_21.label: Change in NINo registrations per 1,000 residents since calendar 2021

value_used.2022-05-05: not defined: base year is the year before polling day

asylum_rate.label: Supported asylum seekers at the last quarter end before polling day, per 1,000 residents
asylum_rate.source: Home Office immigration system statistics, year ending June 2026 (published 27 August 2026), Asy_D11 quarterly supported asylum by local authority; asylumstats area-series.json. Counts: people in receipt of asylum support at quarter end. Denominator: ONS mid-year estimate.

asylum_change_21.label: Change in supported asylum seekers per 1,000 residents since 31 March 2021

value_used.2026-05-07: rate at 2026-03-31 minus rate at 2021-03-31 (mid-2021 population)
value_used.2025-05-01: rate at 2025-03-31 minus rate at 2021-03-31 (mid-2021 population)
value_used.2022-05-05: rate at 2022-03-31 minus rate at 2021-03-31 (mid-2021 population)
value_used.2023-05-04: rate at 2023-03-31 minus rate at 2021-03-31 (mid-2021 population)

income_median.label: Median income of income taxpayers, 2023 to 2024, pounds
income_median.source: HMRC Personal Incomes Statistics 2023 to 2024, Table 3.14 (published 29 April 2026); ukdemographics income-taxpayers-la.json. Counts: median total income of individuals liable to income tax (sample estimate).

value_used.2022-05-05: excluded: the only edition held (2023 to 2024) ends after this polling day
value_used.2023-05-04: excluded: the only edition held (2023 to 2024) ends after this polling day

band_d.label: Band D area council tax in force on polling day, pounds
band_d.source: MHCLG, Council Tax levels set by local authorities in England 2025 to 2026 (revised 22 April 2026) and 2026 to 2027 (25 March 2026), area Band D for two adults including precepts; ukcounciltax data/council-tax/england-*.json.

band_d_rise.label: Band D area council tax rise into the year in force on polling day, per cent
band_d_rise.source: As band_d, plus Council Tax levels 2024 to 2025 (updated 8 May 2024).

hmo_rate.label: Houses in multiple occupation per 1,000 residents, Census 2021
hmo_rate.source: ONS Census 2021 RM192, dwellings that are houses in multiple occupation, over Census 2021 population; ukdemographics hmo-density.json (lastUpdated 2026-04-29).

wb_change_1121.label: Annual change in White British share, Census 2011 to 2021, points a year
wb_change_1121.source: ONS Census 2011 KS201EW and Census 2021 TS021 ethnic group, as held as the base of the UK Demographics projections (ethnic-projections.json, annualChangePp, model version as recorded in the file). Counts: change in the White British share of usual residents, points a year.

value_used.2026-05-07: Census 2011 and Census 2021 composition (the projections' base, not a projected value)
value_used.2025-05-01: Census 2011 and Census 2021 composition (the projections' base, not a projected value)
value_used.2022-05-05: Census 2011 and Census 2021 composition (the projections' base, not a projected value)
value_used.2023-05-04: Census 2011 and Census 2021 composition (the projections' base, not a projected value)

placebo_hash.label: Placebo: fixed pseudo-random number from the district code
placebo_hash.source: None: SHA-256 of a fixed salt and the district code.

placebo_digit.label: Placebo: last digit of the mid-2021 population estimate
placebo_digit.source: Last digit of the ONS mid-2021 estimate (population-estimates.json).

spd_share.label: Single person discount share of chargeable dwellings, 6 October 2025
spd_share.source: MHCLG Council Taxbase 2025 in England (snapshot 6 October 2025, revised 21 January 2026); ukdemographics council-tax-spd.json. Counts: dwellings with a 25% single person discount over chargeable dwellings.

value_used.2025-05-01: excluded: only the 6 October 2025 snapshot is held
value_used.2022-05-05: excluded: only the 6 October 2025 snapshot is held
value_used.2023-05-04: excluded: only the 6 October 2025 snapshot is held

ta_rate.label: Households in temporary accommodation at 31 March 2026, per 1,000 residents
ta_rate.source: MHCLG Statutory homelessness detailed local authority tables, January to March 2026 (13 August 2026, provisional), TA1; asylumstats housing-pressure.json. Counts: households in temporary accommodation at 31 March 2026. Denominator: ONS mid-2025.

value_used.2026-05-07: stock at 31 March 2026 over mid-2025 population
value_used.2025-05-01: excluded: only the 31 March 2026 stock is held
value_used.2022-05-05: excluded: only the 31 March 2026 stock is held
value_used.2023-05-04: excluded: only the 31 March 2026 stock is held

births_nonuk_mother.label: Share of 2025 live births to mothers born outside the UK, per cent
births_nonuk_mother.source: ONS Births in England and Wales: 2025, parents' country of birth, Table 6a (27 May 2026); ukdemographics births-by-mother-cob.json. Counts: live births to mothers born outside the UK over all live births.
